baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ, بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ, and حَاقَ بِهِم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disclosure arrives from outside, but the recipients treat knowledge held near them as a sufficient possession and turn it into arrogant joy. The final enclosure reverses that posture: what they hold cannot keep away what now holds them.

activation_trace.role: Visible uncovering supplies the external disclosure against which their locally held knowledge is measured.
Arrogant joy supplies the affective seal that converts possession of knowledge into self-confirmation.
Nearness and presence make the knowledge a bounded stock that is merely at their disposal.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower supplies the content they treat as already sufficient.
Descending, surrounding harm reverses possession into being possessed by the consequence.

changed_reading.before: They were pleased with their knowledge despite clear proofs, and punishment befell them.
changed_reading.after: Their locally possessed knowledge functions as a self-sealing enclosure: disclosure is converted into triumphant self-confirmation until the mocked reality becomes the enclosure around them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ and the subject reversal in وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messengers make a carried meaning present and disclose it through word or sign. Habitual mockery keeps that meaning at an apparent distance, but the relative construction makes the mocked object the active surrounding force.

activation_trace.role: Bringing and making present supplies the transition from absent warning to an encountered reality.
The carried message and its bearer supply the vehicle by which disclosure enters the encounter.
Meaning uncovered through speech or sign makes the messenger's content intelligible rather than merely spectacular.
Occurrence across time supplies the settled, habitual duration of their mockery.
Mockery supplies the distancing act whose object is about to reverse roles.
Surrounding harm turns the formerly mocked object into the active agent of contact.

changed_reading.before: The warning they mocked eventually happened to them.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages an agency reversal: a message made present by its bearers is held away through habitual ridicule, then the very object of ridicule closes around the ridiculers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger-plus-clear-proof formula recurs across the surah, while 40:78 places a messenger's sign under divine permission. The focus arrival is therefore a cumulative and authorized diagnostic, not a single evidentiary surprise.

activation_trace.role: Making something present anchors the focus encounter that the repeated context formula intensifies.
The message and its bearer anchor the recurring dispatch pattern.
Manifest disclosure anchors what repeatedly accompanies the messengers.
Successive groups supply an earlier historical instance of proof-bearing arrivals.
Visible disclosure fixes the repeated content of that earlier arrival.
Repeated coming within one recollection supplies a contest of renewed arrivals against persistent doubt.
The manifest proofs show that doubt persists after disclosure, not before it.
The recalled succession of messengers makes prior receipt of proofs part of the later reckoning.
Manifest proofs become the fact the recipients themselves must concede.
The arrival of proofs is shown as making a command-bearing disclosure present to the addressee.
Disclosure through sign or statement links proof to a demanded response.
Dispatch and release supply the long sequence of sent messengers culminating near the focus.
Permission supplies the authorization under which a messenger may bring a sign.
The command's arrival makes the endpoint of the authorized warning present.

structural_cues: The paired messenger and clear-proof formula appears at 40:22, 40:50, and 40:83, with close variants at 40:28, 40:34, and 40:66.
40:78 immediately frames messenger signs as permission-bound and joins the coming of the command to judgment in truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent proof-bearing arrivals and explicit authorization; I infer that recurrence makes 40:83 a cumulative test of response rather than a first exposure. A live alternative is that the repetitions only coordinate separate peoples without increasing the culpability implied by the focus.

changed_reading.before: A people rejected one decisive encounter because they preferred their existing knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Their joy survives a recurrent, authorized chain of disclosure; the focus exposes a durable response-pattern that converts repeated evidence into renewed self-certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same joy root is explicitly joined in 40:75 to being without truth and to exuberance beyond measure. That earlier characterization reaches forward into 40:83 and makes knowledge the occasion or warrant for transgressive elation, not a neutral object of intellectual satisfaction.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant joy anchors the affective response whose quality the earlier passage specifies.
Knowledge supplies the possessed content turned into an occasion for exultation.
The repeated root directly characterizes the condemned joy as arrogant rather than innocent.
Truth matching reality supplies the norm explicitly absent from their joy.
Joy exceeding its proper measure supplies the mode of expansion from confidence into swagger.

structural_cues: 40:75 places rejoicing without truth and excessive exultation in one causal indictment only eight ayat before the focus.
The focus repeats joy and then names the object celebrated as their own knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated joy root, the explicit lack of truth, and excessive exultation; I infer that 40:75 colors the manner of joy in 40:83. The alternative is that 40:75 concerns worldly merriment generally, so the backward characterization should not erase the focus's specific epistemic object.

changed_reading.before: They happened to be happy with the knowledge available to them.
changed_reading.after: They use what they call knowledge as an affective warrant for truthless swagger; the defect lies not only in the content known but in the self-expanding joy attached to possessing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier use of حاق identifies the surrounding content as bad punishment, and the later chain scene gives that enclosure a spatial process: collars grip, linked chains extend, bodies are dragged, gates are crossed, and attachment becomes lasting.

activation_trace.role: Harm descending and surrounding anchors the focus's enclosing action.
The earlier matching verb identifies bad punishment as something that descends upon and surrounds a rejecting house.
A collar that binds an organ supplies the first concrete closure around the body.
The neck supplies the bodily site at which surrounding becomes constriction.
Connected links extend the local collar into a continuous containing system.
Dragging and extension supply the forced motion deeper into the enclosure.
An entrance supplies the threshold at which surrounding space becomes an entered destination.
Lasting persistence supplies the temporal closure that follows the spatial one.

structural_cues: 40:45 uses the same enclosing verb with the house of Pharaoh and bad punishment.
40:71-76 proceeds from bodily binding through forced transport to entry and lasting residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier lexical equation and a later binding-to-entry sequence; I infer that this sequence materializes the directional topology of حاق in 40:83. The live alternative is that the chain scene is one consequence among others and should not exhaust the focus verb.

changed_reading.after: The mocked reality closes as a system: first surrounding, then constriction and linked capture, then forced passage through a gate into enduring attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly scales knowledge beyond the focus group's possession: God is knowing, mercy and knowledge encompass everything, hidden betrayal is known, some claims lack knowledge, most people do not know, and rejecters will later know. Against that field, مَا عِندَهُم is conspicuously local and temporally premature.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence delimit the stock of knowledge to what is locally at their disposal.
Knowledge as disclosure anchors the finite possession that the surah's wider epistemic scale revises.
Knowing as a divine attribute opens an epistemic scale not bounded by what a community holds.
Expansiveness contrary to narrowness supplies the encompassing scale applied to mercy and knowledge.
Knowledge joined to all-encompassing scope contrasts directly with the focus group's local stock.
Knowledge of hidden betrayal extends disclosure into what subjects conceal.
An explicit absence of knowledge marks a rival claim as epistemically unsupported.
The majority's failure to know prevents numerical prevalence from proving epistemic adequacy.
Future compelled knowing supplies the temporal correction to present self-satisfaction.

structural_cues: The opening names divine knowing, while 40:7 explicitly couples knowledge with encompassing everything.
The sequence moves through hidden knowledge, unsupported claims, general non-knowing, and the future formula 'they will know' before reaching the focus's 'knowledge at them.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contrast between encompassing, hidden, absent, majority-deficient, future, and locally held knowledge; I infer that عند marks an epistemic horizon rather than mere possession. A live alternative is that عندهم is idiomatic possession and carries no polemical spatial limit by itself.

changed_reading.before: They chose their knowledge over the messengers' proofs.
changed_reading.after: They mistake a bounded and premature epistemic horizon for knowledge as such; their joy confuses what is locally possessed with what encompasses, discloses, and will finally compel recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately around the focus, signs are shown but denied, historical outcomes are offered to directed sight, the group celebrates its knowledge, then punishment is seen and belief no longer benefits. حاق is the cutoff where interpretable disclosure becomes coercive visibility.

activation_trace.role: Manifest disclosure anchors the stage at which recognition remains available without compulsion.
Their claimed knowledge occupies the final interval before seeing replaces interpretive choice.
Surrounding harm supplies the threshold event that closes the interval for useful recognition.
Showing and making visible supply offered signs before punishment is directly seen.
The contrary of recognition names the refusal made while signs remain interpretable.
Directed sight or insight supplies an invited reading of historical evidence before the focus.
The end and outcome supply the historical object that directed sight should infer.
Direct sight supplies the forced recognition that follows the focus's enclosure.
Overwhelming severity supplies what becomes directly visible and prompts their late confession.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the explicit loss of efficacy once recognition is compelled.
A running, followed way makes the cutoff a recurrent pattern rather than an accidental timing rule.

structural_cues: 40:81-85 forms an uninterrupted sequence of shown signs, denied recognition, invited historical observation, self-satisfied knowledge, enclosing punishment, direct sight, and useless late belief.
The repeated temporal hinge لَمَّا in 40:83-85 aligns arrival, enclosure, sight, and belated confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered shift from shown signs to observation, enclosure, direct sight, and non-beneficial faith; I infer that حاق marks the epistemic cutoff between responsive interpretation and compelled perception. The alternative is that the sequence marks only a legal deadline, not a change in mode of knowing.

changed_reading.before: Their knowledge was false, and punishment later proved it false.
changed_reading.after: Their celebrated knowledge occupies the last moment of voluntary interpretation; once the mocked reality surrounds them, knowing collapses into unavoidable seeing, and the recognition produced by sight has lost saving efficacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in inventories riding, transport, benefits, ships, greater strength, monuments, and earnings that fail to suffice. This allows their knowledge to be heard as operational know-how and civilizational capital as well as doctrine: one more accumulated capacity mistaken for self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: What is present at hand supplies the inventory-like framing of knowledge as a possessed resource.
Knowledge supplies the capacity tentatively grouped with nearby material and historical competencies.
Arrogant joy turns the inventory of capacities into a claim of sufficiency.
Undertaking and bearing an affair supplies practical mastery immediately before the focus.
Benefit as the contrary of harm supplies the utilitarian value of the surrounding material capacities.
The ship moving through water supplies a concrete technology of transport and reach.
A lasting mark of what existed supplies the durable record of prior civilizational capacity.
Sufficiency supplies the precise capacity that their greater strength, traces, and gains fail to provide.
Acquiring benefit or provision supplies the accumulated gains placed under the verdict of non-sufficiency.

structural_cues: 40:79-80 lists usable animals, benefits, achieved needs, and carriage by ships immediately before the signs question.
40:82 adds superior strength, lasting traces, and earnings, then denies that these acquisitions sufficed before 40:83 names their knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate inventory of practical affordances and failed civilizational assets; I infer that knowledge may be one possessed capacity within that inventory. The live alternative is that العلم refers narrowly to inherited doctrine or argumentative lore, with the material sequence serving only as a separate sign catalogue.

changed_reading.before: They preferred inherited ideas to prophetic evidence.
changed_reading.after: They celebrate an at-hand stock of know-how, monuments, utility, and gains as if civilizational competence guaranteed truth; the surrounding outcome exposes operational mastery without ultimate sufficiency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant mount-moving image inside the mockery root. It remains anchored in يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ and gains a visible reversal from the surah's dragging, riding, and carrying sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory word-image, never as a replacement lexical gloss for mockery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mount-moving branch of ه ز ء in يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ, reversed by حَاقَ بِهِم.

activation_trace.role: Moving a mount supplies an exploratory driver image inside the focus act of mockery.
Surrounding harm reverses control by making the mockers the contained objects.
Dragging and extension supply the explicit movement of formerly controlling subjects as passive objects.
Riding on a mount supplies the driver-ridden relation that the outlier reverses.
An overtly carried load supplies the passive transport pole of the reversal.

changed_reading.before: They mocked the warning until its punishment surrounded them.
changed_reading.after: As a contained word-image, those who figuratively prodded the warning as something under their control become the moved objects themselves, dragged and carried into the enclosure they mocked.

strongest_changes: The focus arrival becomes the culmination of recurrent, authorized proof-bearing encounters rather than a first exposure.
Their joy in knowledge is specified by 40:75 as truthless, measure-exceeding exultation.
حاق becomes a spatial and temporal closure materialized by collars, linked chains, dragging, gates, and lasting attachment.
The 40:81-85 sequence turns the focus into an epistemic cutoff where offered disclosure becomes forced sight and late recognition loses benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus verse a hinge between two scales and two modes: locally held knowledge versus encompassing knowledge, and interpretable signs versus coercive seeing. It also preserved an exploratory civilizational-capacity reading that a narrower proof-versus-ignorance summary would miss.
remaining_uncertainties: The polemical force assigned to عِندَهُم depends on hearing spatial boundedness inside an idiomatic possession construction.
The civilizational-inventory model is sequence-driven; العلم may instead denote inherited doctrine or argumentative lore more narrowly.
The mount-moving activation of ه ز ء is branch-distant and should remain an explicitly exploratory image.
